page_title: ROM 4-1 LEC | AS Roma v Lecce 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal.
90+3' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
90+1' Medon Berisha (Lecce) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
87' Manu Kone (AS Roma) gets booked for the first time in this match.
86' 4 - 1 Goal! Great play by Niccolo Pisilli releases Manu Kone (AS Roma) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 4:1.
84' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
81' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) replaces Stephan El Shaarawy.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mats Hummels will be replaced by Mario Hermoso (AS Roma).
78' Today's referee Daniele Chiffi rightly decides to book Remi Oudin (Lecce) for his harsh tackle.
73' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
72' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
69' Lecce can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' The game is interrupted. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
66' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) receives a precise pass inside the box from Saud Abdulhamid and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
65' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Lassana Coulibaly is replaced by Medon Berisha (Lecce).
65' Substitution. Gaby Jean makes way for Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
62' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

59' 2 - 1 Stephan El Shaarawy sends a superb cross into the box. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the left post, leaving Wladimiro Falcone beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:1.
58' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared.
56' Substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) on for Alexis Saelemaekers.
55' What a big chance! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
50' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.

50' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Wladimiro Falcone!
49' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Giampaolo decided to make a change. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) is replaced by Tete Morente.
46' Half-time substitution. Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is replaced by Mohamed Kaba.
46' Marco Giampaolo makes a switch. Remi Oudin is coming on in place of Ante Rebic (Lecce) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Chiffi starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Daniele Chiffi signals a set piece.
45+2' The ball falls for Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
40' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Mile Svilar no chance!
40' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Saud Abdulhamid (AS Roma). Lecce are awarded a penalty kick!
36' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
35' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
35' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
33' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
33' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
33' AS Roma continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
32' Ante Rebic (Lecce) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
29' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
28' Referee Daniele Chiffi sees the trip by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
23' Claudio Ranieri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Zeki Celik (AS Roma) suffers an injury and Saud Abdulhamid comes on.
19' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' The game is interrupted now, Zeki Celik (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Stephan El Shaarawy plays a simple square pass into the feet of Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
12' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
11' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
7' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
6' A cross from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.
5' Wladimiro Falcone makes a difficult save to deny Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), who attempted to head beyond the left post from inside the box.
2' Manu Kone (AS Roma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniele Chiffi signals.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
